title: Facet configuration
description: facet.json — what `facet add` copies, where it lands, and which theme it is written against.

base.description: Neutral ramp the semantic tokens are drawn from.

mode.description: Which side of the ramp tokens resolve to. Vela resolves at compile time, so a build has one.

ui.description: Where components land, and how other copied files import them.

dir.description: Directory from the project root. A real path: roblox-ts projects are laid out by Rojo.

import.description: Specifier other copied files use to reach this directory, e.g. `shared/ui`. Omit for relative imports, which need no tsconfig `paths` and so work anywhere.

lib.description: Where helpers land, and how other copied files import them.

dir.description: Directory from the project root. A real path: roblox-ts projects are laid out by Rojo.

import.description: Specifier other copied files use to reach this directory, e.g. `shared/ui`. Omit for relative imports, which need no tsconfig `paths` and so work anywhere.

hooks.description: Where hooks land, and how other copied files import them.

dir.description: Directory from the project root. A real path: roblox-ts projects are laid out by Rojo.

velaConfig.description: Path to the project's Vela config, relative to the project root.

registry.description: Registry to read components from. Omit for the published one; set it to pin a fork or a version.
